name: calibration-unaligned-0
description: A dataset intended to assess model calibration under distributional or alignment shifts, measuring how model confidence estimates align with actual accuracy on unaligned inputs. It evaluates whether models remain well-calibrated when facing data that differ from their training/alignment distribution. Useful for studying confidence reliability and calibration methods.
reputation: Relatively new and specialized; modest adoption among researchers studying model calibration and robustness.
